governed_construct: A JSX element that navigates to an internal (same-site) route: an intrinsic <a> whose href is a root-relative or relative path (string literal or template literal starting with '/' but not '//', or not starting with a scheme/'#'/'mailto:'), or a JSX element used as a link component with a 'to' or 'href' prop whose value is an internal path or a dynamic route expression.
interpretation: The rule requires internal navigation to go through Gatsby's Link so that linked pages are preloaded. An instance conforms only if its JSX tag resolves, by import binding, to the 'Link' export of the 'gatsby' package (named import, aliased named import such as `Link as GatsbyLink`, or member access on a namespace import of 'gatsby'). An instance violates the rule if it is a plain <a> to an internal path, or a link element whose tag name is 'Link' (or similar) but is bound to something else: another router package (react-router-dom, @reach/router, next/link) or a locally defined component. Anchors to external URLs (https:, mailto:, protocol-relative) are not governed. A file with only external links, or no links, is NOT_APPLICABLE. Under all-instances semantics a single non-conforming internal link makes the file VIOLATED, even if other links use Gatsby's Link. Comments and strings mentioning Link do not count.
